india.one_line: OpenAI expands its India leadership, Sarvam AI launches a local token API, and Google brings its Gemini Tasks assistant to India.

themes.title: OpenAI expands India leadership role
themes.text: Pragya Misra will lead OpenAI's business development in India and South Asia, following the company reaching over 100 million weekly users in the country.

stories.headline: OpenAI names Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia

themes.title: Sarvam AI launches local token API
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory to serve global open-weight models and its own Sarvam 105B model via Indian GPU clusters.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI opens Token Factory to run global open-weight models on Indian servers

themes.title: Google rolls out Gemini Tasks in India
themes.text: Google is rolling out its agentic Gemini Tasks assistant for free in India alongside several other markets.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Gemini Tasks assistant for free in six markets
